story.title: The Silence Tax
story.logline: A man discovers his quiet neighborhood is actually a prison that charges him for every sound he makes.
story.twist: The debt is not paid in money, but in the memories of the sounds he made.
story.ending: If silence is golden, why am I suddenly completely empty?

scenes.narration: My house was completely silent, yet my daily bill arrived like clockwork demanding payment for every quiet second.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of a 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn gray hoodie, staring at a glowing digital bill inside a dimly lit minimalist apartment.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up pushing in slowly on his terrified face

scenes.narration: I never played music, I never yelled, and I barely spoke. Why did the system punish my peaceful existence?
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn gray hoodie pacing across his dim minimalist living room, holding a glowing tablet.
scenes.camera: Medium tracking shot following his rapid steps

scenes.narration: The collector knocked on my steel door exactly at midnight, holding a glowing reader that hummed with static.
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn gray hoodie opening his apartment door to a dark corridor where a faceless figure stands.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot looking out into the dark hallway

scenes.narration: You owe for the sound of your own heartbeat, the collector whispered, pointing a glowing probe directly at my chest.
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn gray hoodie backing away in terror as a stranger in a dark coat holds a humming device.
scenes.camera: Low angle shot looking up at the towering collector

scenes.narration: I laughed nervously, but the machine flashed red, instantly taxing the vibration of my nervous vocal cords.
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn gray hoodie gripping his throat in shock as floating red numbers appear in the air.
scenes.camera: Tight focus on his strained hands and neck

scenes.narration: He pressed the reader against my temple, and a sudden wave of sharp static erased my favorite childhood memory.
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn gray hoodie wincing as a bright blue beam touches his head, his eyes clouding over.
scenes.camera: Close-up on his tearful, widening eyes

scenes.narration: The debt was never settled with cash. They take the echoes of your past to fund the quiet future.
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn gray hoodie watching translucent fading images of a beach float away from his hands.
scenes.camera: Medium wide shot with a shallow depth of field

scenes.narration: The collector vanished into the empty corridor, leaving me standing alone in a room that felt suddenly vast.
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn gray hoodie standing alone in the center of his stark, echoing apartment.
scenes.camera: Wide static shot emphasizing his isolation

scenes.narration: I tried to hum the tune my mother taught me, but my mouth formed no sound at all.
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn gray hoodie moving his lips silently in a desperate, failed attempt to make a noise.
scenes.camera: Close-up tracking his trembling, silent lips

scenes.narration: If silence is truly golden, why am I suddenly waking up to find myself completely empty inside?
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn gray hoodie staring blankly into a mirror as the room around him turns to dust.

caption.hook: Peace always comes with a price tag.
caption.title: The Silence Tax
caption.caption: In this neighborhood, every laugh and whisper is carefully weighed and measured. But when the collector finally comes calling, he doesn't want your money--he wants your memories. How much of your past would you trade for quiet?
